livia02.title: The Day of the Flame
livia02.d02: This is your first vigil alone. The flame must not be left alone, not even for the length of a sigh. Do you understand?
livia02.d05: I'll sleep over there, in the portico. If you get scared, sing. The flame likes songs.
livia02.c01: Domícia straightens the girl's tunic, which is still too big for her.
livia02.d06a: Any one you know all the way through. Half-sung songs frighten the fire.
livia02.d06b: Then sing anyway. So that she isn't scared.
livia02.d07: The night is long when you are seven. Outside, the city celebrates the Vestalia: flutes, laughter, the smell of sweet bread with honey.
livia02.d08: And on the other side, by the back wall, something hums through a crack in the floor. A big voice that knows no words.
livia02.e01.hint: To the left, the music of the festival. To the right, the voice in the floor.
livia02.e01.music: Followed the music of the festival.
livia02.e01.voice: Followed the voice in the floor.
livia02.h.amphora.1: The oil amphora is taller than she is. Inside, the oil shines like honey. She could see herself in it, if she dared to come closer.
livia02.h.crack.1: Warm air rises from the crack, smelling of wet earth and of animal. The girl should be afraid. She isn't.
livia02.d09a: Only as far as the gate. Only to see the lights. A little sigh.
livia02.d09b: She presses her ear to the crack. The voice stops. Then, very slowly, something down there presses its ear to the other side.
livia02.d10: The flame goes out. It doesn't dim: it goes out, like a word someone took back.
livia02.d11: For an instant, every shadow in the temple leans the same way. No dog barks in Aurélia. No flute plays.
livia02.d13: The embers are still red inside. There's no time to fetch the tongs, or to wake anyone.
livia02.members.hint: The flame went out, but the embers still live. Gather them all in the middle of the bowl, with your hands.
livia02.members.many: Saved every ember with her bare hands.
livia02.d14: It hurts as nothing has ever hurt. Then the flame comes back, and the pain stays, and both stay with her forever.
livia02.d15: When Domícia wakes, the flame burns high. The girl is sitting with her hands in her lap, wrapped in the hem of her tunic. Domícia asks nothing. She looks at the hands, looks at the flame, and understands.
livia02.d15m: Domícia counts the embers on the altar with her eyes. They are all there. She looks at the girl the way one looks at someone who will be great.
livia02.d16: By morning, the College already knows. The College always knows.
livia02.d17: The flame of Vesta went out last night. For the length of a sigh, they say. Who left the flame alone?
livia02.d19: The Vestal Maxima slept on duty. One fault. It will be written in the book of vows, as the law demands.
livia02.d20: And listen well, Domícia, because I won't say it twice: a Vestal Maxima with two faults is not forgiven. And lying to the College is also a fault.
livia02.c03: Domícia doesn't look at the girl. She doesn't need to.
livia02.c03.silent: Stay silent, as her eyes ask.
livia02.c03.confess: "It wasn't her! It was me who..."
livia02.d21a: Lívia stays silent. Silence is a rope too, and that day she learns to hold the end of it.
livia02.d21b: It wasn't her! It was me who...
livia02.d21b2: The girl is delirious with fever, augur. She burned her hands trying to help me.
livia02.d22: Domícia couldn't use her hands for a month. No one said why. No one needed to.
livia02.d24: Twelve winters. And I still hide my hands when she looks at them.
livia02.d25: At the far end of the Temple, the morning's augur is still there. He doesn't pray, doesn't write. He only watches. First the flame; then, for a long while, Domícia.
livia02.d24song: Sometimes, alone with the flame, she still sings the song from that night. Whole, start to finish, as Domícia told her.
livia02.d24brave: She still tells the flame she is not afraid. Some nights, she almost believes it.
